safety: Photograph with the engine stopped and cold; keep cameras, scales and clothing clear of belts and fans.
Never get underneath a vehicle supported by a jack alone. Use suitable rated supports and the vehicle manufacturer's lifting/support instructions.
This plan does not require dismantling. Capture hidden areas only when safely accessible during otherwise planned work.
common_checklist: Keep original full-resolution photos and an unedited copy of labels/casting codes. Avoid publishing VINs or other personal identifiers.
Capture overlapping context views first, then closer views from several directions; keep some shared rigid landmarks visible across sets.
Use diffuse light, fixed focus/exposure where practical, and sharp photographs. Reflective metal, black hoses and occluded areas may not reconstruct.
Include a rigid measured scale or scale bars visible in multiple views, plus independent caliper/tape measurements for validation.
Record date, vehicle configuration, loaded/lifted state, camera, scale, parts removed and inaccessible areas. Preserve scans as reference geometry, not verified CAD.

jobs.title: Identify the fitted hardware
shots: Engine code and vehicle data sticker (keep VIN private)
Gearbox code stamping and casting marks
Alternator, starter and injection-pump labels; brackets, pulley and connector context
measurements: Record part codes exactly including suffixes; do not infer identity from the model year
jobs.benefit: Resolves candidate-versus-fitted identities before parts ordering or workshop-spec research.

jobs.title: Upper engine bay and mounting context
shots: Wide context from front and both sides, followed by overlapping closer passes
Mounts, bulkhead, brackets, hose routes and rigid shared landmarks
measurements: Engine-to-body reference points; note vehicle level and installed tilt
jobs.benefit: Constrains installed placement and access space; the current body and engine positions remain estimates.

jobs.title: Alternator, brackets and accessory drive
shots: Alternator front, rear and both bracket sides where accessible
Belt paths, pulley offsets, tensioner, connector locations and fastener head faces
measurements: Bracket hole centres and accessible hole/head dimensions measured separately
Pulley diameter and axial alignment; dimensions are not inferred from the 3D mesh
jobs.benefit: High-value improvement for the simplified alternator envelope and repair-access visualization.

jobs.title: Front underbody / pohja and powertrain supports
shots: Safely supported front underside overview, then subframe, sump, mounts and bellhousing
Starter nose, intermediate-shaft support, CV flanges and visible fastener access
measurements: Subframe/mount reference points and accessible shaft centre locations
Bellhousing seam, flange positions and clearances with independent scale checks
jobs.benefit: Addresses drivetrain placement and engine-to-transmission closure against the actual vehicle.

jobs.title: Remaining underfloor and chassis context
shots: Overlapping sections of floor, rails, crossmembers, exhaust and heat shields
Join each section through common rigid landmarks; record missing coverage
measurements: Axle-centre spacing and rigid reference distances; nominal SWB dimensions are not scan calibration
jobs.benefit: Adds broader repair context after the higher-priority front engine-bay and underbody captures.
